featured.name: Microsoft PyRIT
featured.note: Added a memory-backed dataset summary API (#2762, 11 files, with tests) for PyRIT's planned dataset explorer, then four fixes: XInclude-based XXE detection, an empty-string false positive in exact text matching, HarmBench context strings being dropped, and converter identifiers that collided across word-selection strategies.

prs.title: FIX Preserve word-selection parameters in StringJoinConverter identifiers
Fix: exact text matching empty target
FIX Use harmbench context string where available

featured.name: Inspect AI
featured.kind: UK AI Security Institute's LLM evaluation framework
featured.note: With GOOGLE_USE_ADC set, Inspect sent every Gemini call through ambient credentials even when you passed an API key. Now an explicit key wins unless you explicitly pass use_adc=True (#5670, fixes #5358, with tests).

prs.title: fix(google): prefer explicit API keys over ambient ADC

featured.name: aios
featured.note: A streaming trailer could overwrite finish_reason="length", hiding truncated output. I kept the signal through stream assembly (#2457), stamped it on the model-request span with a truncation warning (#2458), made timeouts say whether the deadline or the spend ceiling fired (#2459), and stopped a passthrough from bypassing LiteLLM's parameter translation (#2460).

prs.title: fix: preserve length finish reason across streaming trailers
fix(harness): record streaming length as truncated output
fix(workflow): preserve timeout bound in child outcome
